TRUST ORDINANCE (CHAPTER 87)
Order under Section 114
WHEREAS the Trustees of the “The Arthma Jothi Foundation” namely-
1. Aiyadurai Somaskanda moorthy alias Aiyadurai Thirugnanasampanthan
2. Kandaih Balasubramaniam
have applied to the Minister of Justice and Prison Reforms for their incorporation under Section 114 of theTrusts Ordinance (Chapter 87) ;

Now Therefore, by virtue of the powers vested in me by the aforesaid Ordinance, I, Thalatha Athukorale, Ministerof Justice and Prison Reforms do by this Order, authorize the incorporation of the said Trustees and direct and declarethat-
(a) the Trustees of the said Trust named above and their successors for the time being duly appointed under the

said Trust and the Declaration of the Trust bearing No. 2081 of August 7, 2012 attested by Murugesu andNeelakandan Notaries Public of Colombo as amended by the Trust and the Declaration of the Trust bearingNo. 136 of June 30, 2018 attested by Murugesu and Neelakandan Notaries Public of Colombo shall be a bodycorporate with perpetual succession and a common seal under the name and style of the “The Arthma JothiFoundation” ;

(b) the said Tustees may under the said name and style purchase, receive, hold, take on loan or otherwise acquire,
sell, exchange, mortgage, pledge, lease or otherwise dispose of any property movable or immovable, on behalfof the said Trust ; and
(c) the Trustees shall by the said name and style be able and competent in law to sue and to be sued, to answer and
to be answered, to defend and to be defended, in any Court in Sri Lanka or elsewhere in all cases and actionsarising in relation to the said Trust.
This Order may be revoked, or from time to be varied or amended in such manner as appear to me to be necessary.
